snippet.title: Slime in the Ice Machine (Played for the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase 2026)
snippet.description:
VascoDaGamer has been beta testing a new logic-based puzzle game called "Slime in the Ice Machine" over the last two months and was even asked to showcase his favorite puzzle from the available game so far as part of the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase - a Steam festival highlighting the fun and excitement of puzzle games and others that make you think as you play.

Slime in the Ice Machine is now listed on Steam! If you like what you see here, download the demo for yourself and wishlist the game!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4404940/Slime_in_the_Ice_Machine/

Originally aired on Saturday, May 30th 2026.

Join in for Christmas, chronology and a biblically accurate lewd dude over at www.Twitch.tv/VascoDaGamer

Current Streaming Schedule:
Fridays and Saturdays starting 6pm Pacific Time
